summary: Full-stack E2E validation of Audit Retention Policies & Ephemeral Lifecycle. Backend: 62/62 pytest cases PASS in 51.31s (includes 6 new tests in test_lifecycle_retention.py: retention_defaults_and_env, awaiting_review_protection_and_touch_activity, protected_operation_prevents_cleanup, manual_batch_deletion_isolation, manual_session_deletion_cascading, expired_resource_status_code_410). Live HTTP validation against preview URL: POST /api/sessions -> 200 with session_id; GET /api/sessions/{sid}/expiry -> 200 with {seconds_remaining:~3599, ttl_minutes:60}; DELETE /api/sessions/{sid} -> 200; GET /api/sessions/{sid}/expiry after deletion -> HTTP 410 with body {detail:{code:'RESOURCE_EXPIRED',detail:'RESOURCE_EXPIRED'}} confirming tombstone semantics. Frontend UI on preview URL: Header renders session-ttl-indicator ('⏱️ Auto-eliminación tras 60 min de inactividad'), delete-session-now-btn ('Eliminar sesión ahora'), toggle-batch-mode-btn ('Procesamiento por Lotes') — all visible and clickable. Toggling batch mode renders BatchQueueScreen with delete-batch-now-btn ('Eliminar lote ahora') visible in DOM. delete-session-now-btn click flow (with confirm dialog auto-accepted) reloads app without JS errors after axios import fix.
action_items: None — retention/lifecycle feature works end-to-end. The only fix applied (axios import in Header.js) was a trivial missing-import that would have thrown ReferenceError on delete-session click; main agent should keep this import going forward.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.js originally used axios.delete() at line 60 without importing axios — would throw ReferenceError on click. Fixed by testing agent (added `import axios from 'axios'`).

lifecycle.py::LifecycleManager: correct fine-grained per-session/per-batch/per-document asyncio.Lock isolation; protect_operation context manager uses try/finally so active_operations decrement is guaranteed even on exception/cancellation.

delete_session_now cascades correctly: deletes batches first (which delete their documents), then remaining orphan docs, then physical session dir, then session_store.sessions entry, and adds session_id to expired_sessions tombstone set powering the 410 response.

get_session_expiry endpoint checks is_session_expired BEFORE get_session_expiry_info, ensuring deleted sessions return 410 (not 404). Detail payload correctly includes code=RESOURCE_EXPIRED for machine-parseable client handling.

delete_batch_now correctly isolates: pops only target batch from session_store.batches, cleans event_bus for that batch_id only, and recursively deletes only its docs — sibling batches in same session remain intact (verified by test_manual_batch_deletion_isolation).
cleanup_orphan_directories_on_start scans TEMP_ROOT on manager instantiation and prunes dirs >2h old — prevents disk accumulation across restarts.
Minor (non-blocking, carry-over): App.js still contains http://localhost:8001 fallback for REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — violates fail-fast env policy but out of scope for this feature.
Minor: SessionLifecycleRecord.is_inactivity_expired is a truthy property but is_session_expired also checks active_operations==0 — good, matches the awaiting_review protection contract.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 target data-testids visible & functional; delete-session flow no JS errors after import fix)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression: `cd /app && PYTHONPATH=/app python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v` (62 tests ~52s). Lifecycle tests live in backend/tests/test_lifecycle_retention.py. For live 410 verification: create session via POST /api/sessions -> DELETE -> GET /api/sessions/{sid}/expiry (expect 410 RESOURCE_EXPIRED). Header.js now imports axios — do not remove.
rca of the issue: Only issue found: axios was referenced in Header.js delete-session-now-btn onClick handler but never imported at the top of the file. Root cause: import was missed during Header component enhancement. Reproduction: click delete-session-now-btn in browser -> ReferenceError: axios is not defined -> session never deleted. Mitigation applied: added `import axios from 'axios'` at line 2. Post-fix: click flow completes, DELETE /api/sessions succeeds, page reloads with fresh session.
